notes: Qt/libpng independently reads PNG16 including RGB; a separate TIFF tag/strip parser checks samples and types. Local Linux frozen encoder smoke is not clean-system or cross-platform release acceptance. GUI save controls remain W14. Input identities sample first/last 64KiB, not full-file hashes. Display gamma is an explicit power transfer without colour-space conversion. Interrupted processes may leave unreferenced generation companions. R9 and Q3 unchanged.
protocol: CPU PNG16, TIFF16 and float32 TIFF mono/RGB read-back; fixed shared mapping, invalid masks, coverage pages, provenance, atomic publication and full-resolution intermediate snapshot export.
